technique_name: Suggest a creative way to de-stress after a long day
description: After a long day, it can be helpful to take part in activities that bring joy and relaxation. One creative way to de-stress is to take a few calming breaths and do a self-guided body scan. Start by focusing your attention on your feet and take a few deep breaths, as if you were pouring relaxation into your feet with each breath.
